### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **nuviotv:** correct tracking playback reads and themed sync progress [skip ci] ([3ab9681](https://github.com/Santodan/santodan-patches/commit/3ab9681361fed5c253922155cbcbfb7141bbd852))

### 🚀 Updated App Support

patches.name: MEO - Side-by-side installation
patches.description: Installs a separately named MEO clone using a configurable package name and app name.

options.description: Unique Android package name for this installation.
Name displayed by Android launchers for this installation.

patches.name: MEO - Spoof supported device
patches.description: Reports a Sagemcom DIW3930 to MEO provisioning and skips the server's non-blocking device-verification warning.

patches.name: TFD Companion - NGSM validation diagnostics - Troubleshooting purpose
patches.description: Logs NGSM token-result codes and failed validation values under TFD-NGSM. Does not log tokens or change authentication results.

patches.name: TFD Companion - Remove illegal apps detection
patches.description: Removes broad MAIN/VIEW package queries while preserving specific app integrations. For Android 11+. Leaves NGSM and authentication unchanged; other detections may still occur.

patches.name: NuvioTV - Android TV launcher channels
patches.description: Choose individual catalogs and tracking lists, Library, and Upcoming to publish as Android TV launcher channels.

patches.name: NuvioTV - Finale dates in library and collections
patches.description: Adds separate disabled-by-default settings to show the latest scheduled episode date in library and collection posters.

patches.name: NuvioTV - Keep airing series in Upcoming
patches.description: Adds a disabled-by-default setting that keeps currently-airing library series in Upcoming until the scheduled finale.

patches.name: NuvioTV - Merge tracking progress
patches.description: Merges Nuvio Sync and connected tracking-provider progress, preserving the previous snapshot while providers refresh.

patches.name: NuvioTV - Preload streams for next episode
patches.description: Adds an opt-in Streams setting to fetch the next episode's source list after 30 seconds of playback, reusing Nuvio's native search cache.

patches.name: NuvioTV - Preload streams in Continue Watching
patches.description: Adds an opt-in Streams setting to search sources in the background for visible Continue Watching episodes and movies, reusing Nuvio's native search cache.

patches.name: NuvioTV - Preload streams on detail page
patches.description: Adds an opt-in Streams setting to search sources for the detail page's Play or Resume episode or movie, reusing Nuvio's native search cache.

patches.name: NuvioTV - Remaining episodes in Continue Watching
patches.description: Adds a disabled-by-default setting that displays aired, unwatched episode counts for every tracking integration. Controlled by Settings > Layout > Santodan-Patches.

patches.name: NuvioTV - Side-by-side installation
patches.description: Installs a separately named NuvioTV clone using a configurable package name and app name.

options.description: Unique Android package name for this installation, for example com.nuvio.testing.one.
Name displayed by Android launchers for this installation.

patches.name: NuvioTV - Upcoming movie dates in library and collections
patches.description: Adds separate disabled-by-default settings to show known release dates on unreleased movie posters in library and collections.

patches.name: Car Scanner - Premium status
patches.description: Makes the managed premium-status getter return true in Car Scanner 2.1.50.

patches.name: Reddit - Content filters (Experimental)
patches.description: Adds keyword and per-community flair filters under Morphe > Filters. Home-feed flair filtering requires Show flairs in home feed, which is installed automatically.

patches.name: Reddit - Show flairs in home feed (Experimental)
patches.description: Shows native post flair badges below titles in the home feed, including cached and joined-community posts. Controlled by Morphe > Layout.

patches.name: Reddit - Start as guest
patches.description: Skips the forced startup login screen using Reddit's native browse-logged-out action. Login remains available from the account menu. Already included upstream in Morphe Patches PR #3109: https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/pull/3109

patches.name: Peafowl - Unlock Theme Ownership (Experimental)
patches.description: Use Peafowl's local free-theme path without the billing preflight. Experimental; server downloads are not guaranteed.

patches.name: Pillo - Hybrid Lock-Screen Notifications
patches.description: Use fullscreen alarms while the phone is locked and banner notifications while it is unlocked. Select Pillo's Banner/Light notification mode.

patches.name: Pillo - Import weight history from JSON
patches.description: Adds a native Import weights JSON button above Skip in Weight > Add record. Imports SWT backup weights with their dates into the selected profile, with kg/lb selection and duplicate skipping.

patches.name: Pillo - Local backup and restore
patches.description: Adds local-file export and restore of Pillo's database, settings and app-managed files, without Google sign-in. Restore replaces current data, keeps a recovery backup and restarts Pillo.

patches.name: Pillo - Weight change summaries
patches.description: Adds signed Total weight change, an All default filter, a selectable Last since date, and Last 30 days / Last 15 days / Change summaries using full profile history.
